entries.1a8b07edd6f78825: This business supports companies' sales promotion activities. It handles planning and production of SP support materials and information magazines, field services, campaign planning, entry processing, planning, development and production of goods and novelties, marketing research, telemarketing and web marketing, and also focuses on support services that make use of its call center and back-office functions. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥629 million.
entries.1c1badde99f9d103: This business provides end-to-end outsourcing of direct mail, from planning and production to data processing, inserting and sealing, dispatch, and handling orders and inquiries after dispatch. It equips its own centers with equipment that outputs address data received from client companies and performs inserting and sealing, and dispatch is carried out through postal and parcel delivery operators. The Urawa Logistics Center in Saitama City, Saitama Prefecture, is also a base for this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥24,829 million, and Japanet Media Agency Co., Ltd. is listed as a major customer in the segment note.

entries.fba700454599fd91: This business handles logistics operations for both consumers and companies, from proposal to operation, including shipping agency for mail-order products, delivery of campaign prizes, and storage, management and dispatch of promotional items and office supplies between branches and stores.
